company.shortDescription: Concourse is an AI agent platform that helps corporate finance teams by automating financial analysis, reporting, and data workflows.
company.description: Concourse is a company that provides an AI platform designed to support corporate finance teams by automating financial analysis, reporting, and data workflows. It offers AI agents that connect with existing financial systems and allow users to query financial data, generate reports, and run forecasts using natural language without needing manual data manipulation or technical setup. The platform integrates with a wide range of systems to centralize data for analysis and enables teams to produce charts, variance explanations, and ad-hoc insights. Concourse also includes features for collaborative editing, commentary, and exporting outputs to common formats like spreadsheets and presentations.
